name: game-tracker-bot
install:
bun_version=$(sed -n 's/.*"packageManager": "bun@\([^"]*\)".*/\1/p' package.json)
if [ "$(bun --version 2>/dev/null)" != "$bun_version" ]; then curl -fsSL https://bun.sh/install | bash -s "bun-v$bun_version"; fi
export PATH="$HOME/.bun/bin:$PATH"
hash -r
bun --version
for cursor_profile in "$HOME/.bashrc" "$HOME/.bash_profile"; do
  cursor_profile_tmp=$(mktemp "${cursor_profile}.XXXXXX")
  printf 'export PATH="%s:%s:$PATH" # cursor-cloud-bun\n' "$HOME/.bun/bin" "$HOME/.railway/bin" > "$cursor_profile_tmp"
  if [ -f "$cursor_profile" ]; then sed -e '/# cursor-cloud-bun$/d' -e '/# cursor-cloud-node24$/d' "$cursor_profile" >> "$cursor_profile_tmp"; fi
  mv "$cursor_profile_tmp" "$cursor_profile"
done
# bun run verify reads production over railway ssh
curl -fsSL https://railway.com/install.sh | sh -s -- --yes
bun install --frozen-lockfile
